label: log(close_at_origin_plus_horizon / close_at_origin)
maturity: endpoint + 60 seconds strictly before the training fit cutoff or evaluation end; historical first-seen times remain unknown
purge: all feature and label intervals stay in development; training label endpoint plus observation delay strictly precedes fit cutoff; feature intervals of scored origins begin more than 28 days after fit cutoff; touching boundaries excluded

ridge.standardization: training-only population mean and standard deviation; constant features use scale 1

probabilistic.family: training-only empirical distribution of horizon returns divided by origin trailing-24-hour root-mean-square hourly return times sqrt(horizon_hours); evaluation rescales that frozen empirical distribution using only the scored origin trailing returns
probabilistic.quantile_rule: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q in the sorted training sample
probabilistic.direction_probability: Jeffreys-smoothed positive fraction of nonzero training standardized returns; true zero labels excluded from binary scores and counted
probabilistic.calibration: report observed calibration; never assume calibrated; no fitted calibration or use of the policy calibration partition

comparison.pairs: identical per-horizon asset/origin/outcome identities across all algorithms; fail comparison if identities or exclusions differ
comparison.primary: return MAE; equal weight assets then horizons; strongest point-baseline selected on this development fold only
comparison.bootstrap: paired chronological moving-block bootstrap of UTC daily loss sums/counts; identical sampled origin windows across assets and algorithms; 2000 draws; seed 42
comparison.dependence: estimate from training-only daily mean returns and absolute returns: largest lag up to 112 days with absolute autocorrelation exceeding 2/sqrt(n), plus one day; block duration is max(registered minimum, horizon, dependence span); insufficient effective blocks denies a claim
comparison.multiplicity: Holm familywise alpha 0.05 over all declared algorithm/horizon contrasts; simultaneous 95-percent lower bounds use Bonferroni family tails; failed trials remain in the declared family
comparison.decision: retain the strongest registered baseline; no challenger promotion, final claim or profitability inference; null or insufficient evidence retains baseline

fixed_job: application-owned PI03 task only; versioned canonical request binds algorithm, spec, source rights, snapshot, development input and attempt fence; shared durable job state machine and verified CPU controls; controls checked before fitting and before result acceptance
result: immutable development result binds job, attempt, algorithm, spec, input and paired origin/outcome digests; records scores, daily loss sums/counts, exclusions, parameters, resource usage, evidence limitations and final_labels_accessed=false
